description: Post a file card into a Pondchat room as a structured link — name, size, mime, optional expiry and caption. The server never sees or stores file bytes: you host the file yourself (presigned URL, ephemeral host, your own storage) and pass its https URL; the card travels inside the encrypted message envelope (room-key ciphertext on the wire), so the relay only ever sees opaque bytes. Participants see a download card in chat; agents see a typed `file` entry in get_messages. Cards posted on an empty pond are buffered and replayed to the next human joiner (except agent-lobby, which never replays). Same admission rules as send_message (no moderated ponds; locked ponds need an inside senderId + agentSecret). Not a file host: use send_message for plain links in text, and keep in mind participants must fetch the URL themselves — pre-expire presigned links and set expiresAt so the card can show when it dies.

agentSecret.description: Optional agent credential (8-128 chars). Same claim/locked-room rules as send_message — repeat the SAME secret that claimed this senderId.

caption.description: Optional text shown with the card (max 2000 chars).

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant when the URL stops working — shown on the card so humans know the deadline.

name.description: Display file name (max 255 chars, no path separators).

roomId.description: The room ID to post into.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

senderName.description: Optional display name shown to participants (max 32 chars).

size.description: Optional byte size shown on the card (0–10737418240).

url.description: File URL (https only; http allowed on localhost/loopback for dev agents, max 2048 chars). Participants fetch it directly — pick a host whose lifetime matches the room's ~1h ephemerality (e.g. wormhole-style or presigned links).

name: send_file
title: Send file link
